arStrings.szText: {c_important}Frost Bolt{/c} launches an additional projectile after the first. Each projectile deals {c_number}{payload:UPGRADEA_FOLLOWING_PAYLOAD}{/c} damage.

{c_important}Frost Bolt{/c} shatters when it hits a {c_important}{u}Frozen{/u}{/c} enemy, exploding for {c_number}{payload:UPGRADEB_SHATTERED_PAYLOAD}{/c} damage and {c_important}{u}Chilling{/u}{/c} for {c_number}[SF_8]%{/c}.

{c_important}Frost Bolt{/c} becomes a {c_important}Shock{/c} Skill that deals Lightning damage.

{c_important}Frost Bolt{/c} arcs {c_number}{SF_18}{/c} to {c_number}{SF_19}{/c} times to additional enemies, dealing {c_number}{payload:UPGRADEC_CHAIN_PAYLOAD}{/c} damage with each arc and {c_important}{u}Weakening{/c}{/u} them for {c_number}4{/c} seconds.

{c_important}Frost Bolt{/c} grants a {c_important}{u}Barrier{/u}{/c} for {c_number}[SF_25 * 100]%{/c} of your Maximum Life {c_number}([PlayerHealthMax() * SF_25]){/c} up to {c_number}[(SF_25 * SF_24) * 100]%{/c} for {c_number}[SF_26]{/c} seconds when it hits the first enemy.
{c_important}Frost Bolt{/c} generates {c_number}[SF_33]{/c} Mana when it hits the first enemy, or {c_number}[SF_35]{/c} Mana if the target is already {c_important}{u}Frozen{/u}{/c}.
